headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: August 9, 2026**
article:
The New York Yankees edged the Atlanta Braves 5-4 in a narrow victory, with Gerrit Cole leading the way on the mound. Cole tossed 7.0 innings with 9 strikeouts and 2 earned runs. In other action, the Oakland Athletics secured a 7-3 victory over the Boston Red Sox, with Tyler Soderstrom hitting a home run and driving in one run in four at-bats.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, including Tampa Bay Rays second baseman Ben Williamson, who has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a right hamstring strain. Williamson's injury will require a minimum 10-day recovery period. Other notable injuries include Cole Wilcox of the Seattle Mariners, Joe Ryan of the Minnesota Twins, Slade Cecconi of the Cleveland Guardians, Chris Murphy of the Chicago White Sox, Joey Bart of the Chicago White Sox, Luis Urías of the Toronto Blue Jays, and Luinder Avila of the Kansas City Royals.

The Kansas City Royals made a move to bolster their lineup, acquiring first baseman Jacob Berry from the Miami Marlins. Berry joins the Royals in a trade that brings new depth to the team's infield. Other notable trades include the Athletics acquiring Seth Johnson from the Philadelphia Phillies, the Marlins trading Lake Bachar to the Pittsburgh Pirates, and the Colorado Rockies trading Victor Vodnik to the Marlins.

top_news.title: **Braves Fall Short in Bronx Showdown**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees edged the Atlanta Braves 5-4, securing a narrow victory. Gerrit Cole led the way for the Yankees, tossing 7.0 innings with 9 strikeouts and 2 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Athletics Take Down Red Sox 7-3**
top_news.summary: The Oakland Athletics secured a 7-3 victory over the Boston Red Sox, with Tyler Soderstrom leading the team at the plate. Soderstrom hit a home run and drove in one run in four at-bats.

top_news.title: **Marlins Shut Down Angels 7-0**
top_news.summary: The Miami Marlins dominated the Los Angeles Angels in a 7-0 victory, with Sandy Alcantara leading the way on the mound. Alcantara pitched 7.0 innings, striking out 8 batters and allowing no earned runs.

top_news.title: **Blue Jays Take Down Phillies 7-5**
top_news.summary: The Toronto Blue Jays secured a 7-5 victory over the Philadelphia Phillies, with Nathan Lukes leading the offense. Lukes hit 3 home runs, including a key 6th homer that scored Brandon Valenzuela.

top_news.title: **Rays Place Williamson on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Tampa Bay Rays second baseman Ben Williamson has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a right hamstring strain, effective retroactive to August 6, 2026. Williamson's injury will require a minimum 10-day recovery period.

top_news.title: **Royals Acquire Jacob Berry in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Kansas City Royals have made a move to bolster their lineup, acquiring first baseman Jacob Berry from the Miami Marlins. Berry joins the Royals in a trade that brings new depth to the team's infield.
